guarantee: Task-body projection avoids canonical task-corpus enumeration: it opens its addressed document, graph-named schema-valid masters and their explicitly listed valid task documents for sprint annotations, plus the owning master and explicitly listed tasks for ordinary dependency facts; it does not discover another master by corpus enumeration. Always-on projection retains its separate canonical folder enumeration and ordering. Current direct-grant annotations and schema-bearing document admission remain shared; addressed census and the admitted legacy unaddressed fallback are explicit additional I/O, not a zero-directory-I/O claim.
title: Bounded task-document read with unchanged meaning
